_lisezmoi: Registre des sources et des frais nationaux. Règles des États : states.json (data-src/states.py, table ASRT + pages officielles des agences, lues le 2026-11-13). Programmes : programs.json (data-src/build-programs.py, fichiers IPEDS de NCES, domaine public). Frais ARRT lus sur arrt.org (Application Fees) et ARDMS sur inteleos.org (pages d'examen), le 2026-11-13, par curl. Montants de renouvellement annuel ARRT et ARDMS non lus sur une page officielle (contenu en JavaScript) : non affichés.

arrt.renewal: every year, by the last day of the birth month
arrt.cqr: every 10 years for R.T.s certified since January 1, 2011

ardms.renewal: every year, fees due by December 31 (renewal opens in September)

label.en: American Society of Radiologic Technologists (ASRT), States That Regulate: licensure by state and modality (read November 13, 2026)
ARRT, Maintaining your certification and registration: annual renewal, continuing education every two years, Continuing Qualifications Requirements (CQR) (read November 13, 2026)
ARRT, State Licensing: “more than 75% of states have licensing laws” (read November 13, 2026)
Inteleos (ARDMS), Sonography Principles and Instrumentation exam: $275, five-year rule (read November 13, 2026)
Inteleos (ARDMS), Abdomen exam: $300, for RDMS (read November 13, 2026)
Inteleos (ARDMS), Obstetrics and Gynecology exam: $300, for RDMS (read November 13, 2026)
Inteleos (ARDMS), Adult Echocardiography exam: $300, for RDCS (read November 13, 2026)
Inteleos (ARDMS), Vascular Technology exam: $300, for RVT (read November 13, 2026)
Inteleos (ARDMS), Annual Renewal Fee: calendar-year cycle, due December 31 (read November 13, 2026)
NCES, IPEDS completions file C2024_A: awards by program (CIP 51.0910 sonography, 51.0911 radiography), July 2023 to June 2024 (downloaded November 13, 2026)
NCES, IPEDS directory file HD2024: name, city, state and control of each institution
NCES, IPEDS charges file IC2023_AY: 2023-24 tuition and per-credit charges
NCES, IPEDS charges file IC2023_PY: 2023-24 whole-program tuition of certificate programs
